settled.point: the wording of the show-the-rate clause
settled.decided: It is a second sentence on the Nothing wrong prints line, after the message sentence: The `accountant` checks the client's tax rate on the tax line, such as `Tax (7%) 7.00 EUR`, before sending.
settled.ground: The Cut puts the clause in this idea. One sentence holding both would make two points in over 20 words (refactor-doc N5.1), so each point gets its own short sentence. Checking the rate before sending is how the accountant spots a mistyped rate before the invoice goes out, in the person's own example. It uses the name the client's tax rate, which the names decision keeps for the rate.
